svg.text: Film Format is set by the pair.
Sections marked with the link change both halves:
one roll is one stock, one print, one development.
The rest belongs to the half picked above, or on the
canvas: exposure, white balance, placement, crop,
Framing the right half in its slot. Return develops; Esc puts it back.
4 · Framing a half: the slot is fixed, the picture moves
The crop tool on a pair frames the picked half inside its 3:4 slot (4:3 when stacked): drag to move, scroll to scale.
The other half dims while framing. The frame’s own crop (used when it is shown alone) is not changed (D7).
Crop in the rail reads “Right half · 3:4”. Straighten and flips work on the half as on a frame.
A landscape frame paired side by side starts centred in its portrait slot. Nothing is ever stretched.
